skirmish.module.scoreboard.name: Scoreboard
skirmish.module.scoreboard.description: The server's sidebar (HolyWorld's board) in a Skirmish panel instead of vanilla's grey box: a title with an accent underline, even padding, blank lines as thin dividers and the red numbers hidden. It is a HUD element, so move and scale it in the HUD editor. The server's text, colours and icons stay.
skirmish.module.scoreboard.setting.title: Title
The board's name on top with an accent underline
skirmish.module.scoreboard.setting.numbe: Show the numbers on the right (red in vanilla)
skirmish.module.scoreboard.setting.divid: Blank lines become a thin line; blank lines at the top and bottom are dropped
skirmish.module.scoreboard.setting.shado: A shadow under the lines' text, like chat
skirmish.module.scoreboard.setting.opaci: How solid the panel's background is
